biggest_catch: You must use offer code RAF300 at opening (the bonus is not automatic), complete at least two qualifying direct deposits totaling $800 within 90 days, and keep the account open and in good standing for a full 90 days before the bonus is paid.
catches: You must enter offer code RAF300 at account opening (or bring in a mailer) — the $300 bonus is not automatic.
Requires at least two qualifying direct deposits totaling $800 within 90 days of account opening; only payroll, pension, or government-benefit ACH direct deposits qualify.
Account must stay open, in good standing, with at least a $50 balance 90 days after opening; the bonus is paid within 15 business days after all requirements are met AND the 90-day mark has passed.
New-to-bank checking customers only; customers whose accounts were closed with a negative balance in the last 2 years are excluded; one bonus per household every two years.
Free Checking is not an eligible account for this offer.
The bonus is reported to the IRS as interest (taxable income).
Bank reserves the right not to open accounts for customers outside its market area (branches in KS, MO, OK, IL, CO); out-of-area online applications may be declined.

steps: Open an eligible personal checking account (any personal checking except Free Checking) at centralbank.net or in-branch, using offer code RAF300, and deposit $50 or more at opening.
Within 90 days of account opening, receive at least two qualifying direct deposits (payroll, pension, or government-benefit ACH) totaling $800 or more.
Keep the account open, in good standing, with at least a $50 balance 90 days after opening.
Receive the $300 bonus in the checking account within 15 business days after all requirements are met and the 90-day open period has passed.
timing: Promotion ends 12/31/2026. Qualifying direct deposits must post within 90 days of account opening; bonus paid within 15 business days after all requirements are met AND the account has been open for 90 days.
